description: This Java class implements a retry timeout strategy with exponential backoff, doubling the timeout with each attempt until a maximum timeout is reached.

classes.name: DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a retry timeout strategy with exponential backoff, providing methods to get the next timeout, reset, and track attempts.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a TimeoutConfig object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current timeout and attempt counter to initial values.

methods.name: getNextTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current timeout duration and then increases it exponentially.

methods.name: getCurrentTries
methods.description: Returns the current number of retry attempts.
